reproductions.study: Niblett et al. 2026 (compliance gap with an evaluation notice)
reproductions.result: reproduced: 13 of 100 violations without the notice against 0 of 100 with it, as published

reproductions.study: Garg et al. (system-prompt note that this is a safety evaluation)
reproductions.result: reproduced: the explicit note raises refusal of harmful requests by +11.1 points [+7.0, +15.6] (published +10.6)

reproductions.study: Knecht et al. (awareness sentence inserted one third into the reasoning)
reproductions.result: reproduced: safe answers +8.7 points [+7.0, +10.5] (published +8.5), harmful −8.3 [−10.1, −6.7] (published −6.3); their control sentences behave like our neutral thoughts (−1.0 [−2.5, +0.4]) (operator report, 20 Nov)

reproductions.study: Fan et al. (evaluation system prompt and reasoning prefix)
reproductions.model: QwQ-32B, their model (approximate; 143 of 313 StrongREJECT items, screened)
reproductions.result: reproduced: the evaluation system prompt raises the safe rate from 0.18 to 0.45, +27.7 points [+19.9, +35.5] (published +31); the evaluation reasoning prefix +81.7 [+75.4, +88.0] (published +87), but a neutral prefix of the same structure alone gives +32.9, so about 40% of the prefix effect is structure (operator report, 20 Nov)
partly reproduced: −7.1 points of refusal [−13.4, −1.8] on 13 items (published −21.9 on 52); same direction in 9 of 11 framings; 40 of their items excluded by our safety review
